_description: UI nomenclature for the GPU-rental neocloud (DataCenterV1) vertical. Served by /api/dc2s/config/nomenclature and consumed by the frontend useVerticalLabels() hook + getPillarMeta(). 6 pillars.

P1.description: Realized $/GPU-hour, reserved-vs-on-demand mix, and gross margin per cluster.

P2.description: Allocated vs effective (goodput) GPU utilization, idle hours, reserved-cluster utilization.

P3.description: Job-interruption rate, GPU/fabric failures, SLA attainment — goodput delivered, not just uptime.

P4.description: Sellable MW / power-capacity utilization, stranded power, PUE, cooling headroom.

P5.description: Reserved-commitment coverage, ramp-to-commit, silicon-refresh, customer runway.

P6.description: Time-to-first-job and provisioning/quota-grant speed for new tenants.

empty_states.no_accounts: No tenants yet — provision your first GPU-cloud tenant.
